_note: T-027 draft shot list of the main film (docs/video/FILM-PROGRESS.md). Camera keys: t = seconds from the shot start, target = [x, y, z] m in the CAD frame (nose -x, wing +x, z up), az = azimuth deg from the nose (90 = left), el = elevation deg, dist = m. All keys of a scene form one smooth path (cuts only between scenes); the first shot of a scene needs a key at t = 0. parts: 'all' or a list of part-id prefixes; modes: {prefix: normal|ghost|fab|move|hidden}. tag: on-screen tag text (ILLUSTRATIVE = authored motion). todo: placeholder card text. card: closing card, values read from qp/A/params-A.json at draw time (key paths).
